facts.fact: An ESCWA report for Libya's General Information Authority, dated December 2025, proposes a four-phase project (preparation 3 months, design 6-9 months, implementation 6-9 months, sustainability) to create a national interoperability framework, LyGIF, and says the Authority 'can launch' it; the conceptual model, specifications and governance are still to be produced in the design phase, and the report names no adopted or drafted national framework.

The December 2025 ESCWA report treats LyGIF as a future project whose compliance monitoring and onboarding of agencies come only in later phases, and states no decree, law or circular requiring public bodies to follow a framework and no bodies exchanging data under one.
